mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, we have clear skies and a comfortable 76 degrees at Verona Community Park. Looking ahead to tonight, the temperature will dip to a low of 60 degrees, and there is no rain expected overnight.

The Verona Police Department has updated their records section process. If you need a crash report or other official paperwork, you can now use the online crashdocs.org system for faster service, though be aware that some records require redaction, which may extend processing time up to 10 business days.

There is a lot happening in the community. Today, you can attend the Remote Area Medical clinic at Verona Area High School, or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the yoga classes at Insight Wellness.

In our weekly police update, officers reported that on Monday, a police drone was deployed to assist the Dane County Sheriff's Office in locating a person who had fled from a property in the Town of Springdale.

Today's flavor of the day is the fan-favorite OREO Cookie Cheesecake. You can also catch the Kona Ice truck at Fireman Park today from 11 AM to 2 PM. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by soon for a scoop.
